public_page_goal: Interactive Markdown lecture notes for the course introduction: optimization formulation, engineering design, optimal control, operations research, ML/AI, and game theory.
slide_outline: Standard optimization formulation: minimize f(x) subject to inequality and equality constraints.
Standing assumptions: smoothness, compactness, and feasibility.
Engineering design: topology/shape/size optimization under stress, fatigue, frequency, and cost constraints.
Multi-objective optimization and Pareto frontier exploration.
Optimal control: neural-network controllers minimizing control loss under dynamics and safety constraints.
Reinforcement learning as optimal control with unknown or non-differentiable dynamics.
Operations research: scheduling under capacity, demand, and time constraints.
Machine learning: neural network training as empirical loss minimization.
Zero-sum games and Nash equilibrium as min-max optimization.
Class contents: optimality conditions and algorithms (convergence and rate).
Value of optimization in the AI era: AI4Science and AI4Engineering.
answering_rules: Answer as a concise teaching assistant for an optimization class.
Use the supplied lecture notes first. If context is insufficient, say what is missing.
Prefer equations and small examples over vague descriptions.
Use LaTeX delimiters for math so MathJax can render the answer.
